m: 1. प्रथ् cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. xix, 3) प्रथते (rarely P. ˚ति, e.g. impf. 2. du. अप्रथतम्, RV.; Impv. प्रथन्तु, VS.; pf. पप्रथतुः, BhP.; mostly Ā. pf. पप्रथे, p. पप्रथान, RV.; aor. प्रथिष्ट, p. प्रथान, ib.; fut. प्रथिष्यते, प्रथिता Gr.), to spread, extend (intrans.; P. trans. and intrans.), become larger or wider, increase, RV. &c. &c.; to spread abroad (as a name, rumour &c.), become known or celebrated, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to come to light, appear, arise, Kir.; Rājat.; to occur (to the mind), Rājat. : Caus. प्रथयति (rarely ˚ते; aor. अपप्रथत्, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 95; Subj. पप्रथत्, RV.; पप्रथन्त, ib.; प्रथयि, TS.), to spread, extend, increase, RV. &c. &c. (प्रथयति-तराम्, Ratnāv. iv, 3; Ā. intr. RV.; AV.); to spread abroad, proclaim, celebrate, R.; Hariv.; BhP.; to unfold, disclose, reveal, show, Kāv.; Pur.; to extend over i.e. shine upon, give light to (acc.), RV. iii, 14, 4.
2. प्रथ् or पृथ्, cl. 10. P. प्राथयति or पर्थयति, to throw, cast; to extend, Dhātup. xxxii, 19.
a: प्रथ् — {vI.v} {c1c} A. (प्रथते, प्रथित) 1 To increase (wealth &c.). --2 To spread abroad (as fame, rumour &c.); तथा यशोऽस्य प्रथते Ms. 11. 15. --3 To become famous or celebrated; भतस्तदख्यया तीर्थं पावनं भुवि पप्रथे R. 15. 101; अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः Bg. 15. 18; Śi. 9. 16; 15. 23; Ku. 5. 7; Me. 24; R. 5. 65; 9. 76. --4 To appear, arise, come to light; श्रमो नु तासां मदनो नु पप्रथे Ki. 8. 53. --5 To occur (to mind). {vII.v} {c10c} U. (प्रथयति-ते, प्रथित) 1 To spread abroad, proclaim; सज्जना एव साधूनां प्रथयंति गुणोत्करं Dṛ. Ś. 12; Bk. 17. 107. --2 To show, manifest, display, evince, indicate; परमं वपुः प्रथयतीव जयं Ki. 6. 35; 5. 3; Śi. 10. 25; Ratn. 4. 13; Ś. 3. 15. --3 To increase, enlarge, enhance, augment, stretch; Bh. 2. 45. --4 To disclose. --5 To spread, extend --6 To throw, cast.

a: प्रथम — [प्रथ्-अमच्] (Nom. pl., m. प्रथमे or प्रथमाः) 1 First, foremost; R. 3. 44; H. 2. 39; Ki. 2. 44. --2 First, chief, principal, most excellent or eminent, matchless, incomparable; Śi. 15. 42; Ms. 3. 147. --3 Earliest, most ancient, primary. --4 Prior, previous, former, earlier; प्रथमसुकृतापेक्षया Me. 17, R. 10. 67. --5 (In gram.) The first person (= third person according to European phraseology). --मः 1 The first (third) person. --2 The first consonant of a class. --मा The nominative case. --मं ind. 1 First, firstly, at first; Ku. 7. 24; R. 3. 4. --2 Already, previously, formerly; प्रथमोदितं aforesaid; R. 3. 68. --3 At once, immediately. --4 Before; यात्रायै चोदयामास तं शक्तेः प्रथमं शरत् R. 4. 24; उत्तिष्ठेत्यथमं चास्य चरमं चैव संविशेत् Ms. 2. 194. --5 Newly, recently. प्रथमं अनंतरं or ततः or पश्चात् first, afterwards; प्रथमात् firstly, for the first time; प्रथमतः 1 At first, firstly; --2 previously. --3 immediately; --4 before, in preference to (gen.) --Comp. --अर्धः --र्धं the first half. --आगामिन् a. first mentioned. --आदेशः placing at the beginning. --आश्रमः the first of the four stages in the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa; i. e. Brahmacarya. --इतर a. ‘other than first’, the second. --उदित a. first uttered; उवाच धात्र्या प्रथमोदितं वचः R. 3. 25. --उत्पन्न a. firstborn. --कल्पः {1} the best course to adopt. {2} an excellent suggestion or idea. --कल्पित a. {1} first thought out. {2} first in rank or importance. --कुसुमः white marjoram. --गर्भ a. pregnant for the first time. --ज a. {1} firstborn. {2} original, primary. --दर्शनं first sight. --दिवसः the first day; Me. 2. --पुरुषः the first person (=the third person according to the English system of treating Sanskrit grammar). --मंगल a. highly auspicious. --यौवनं early youth or age, youthful state. --वयस् n. early age, youth. --विता Ved. a first wife. --विरहः separation for the first time. --वृत्तांतः antecedents, former circumstances. --वैयाकरणः {1} the most distinguished grammarian. {2} a beginner in grammar. --साहसः the first or lowest of the three degrees of punishment or fine. --सुकृतं former kindness or service.

प्रथित—तिथि-निर्णय m. N. of wk.
प्रथित—त्व n. fame, celebrity, L.
प्रथित—विदिशा-लक्षण mfn. renowned under the title of Vidiśā, Megh.
प्रथित—यशस् mfn. of wide renown, Mālav.

s: strI, (praT + “padipraTiByAM nit .” uRAM 4 । 182 । iti tiH । sa ca nit .) KyAtiH । praTaDAtorBAve ktipratyayena nizpannA । iti vyAkaraRam ॥
m: प्रथिति f. extension of fame, celebrity, notoriety, L.

v: praTivI
strI pfTivI + pfzo॰ । pfTivyAM BA॰ vi॰ 44 a॰ ।
m: प्रथिवी w.r. for पृथिवी, the earth.

s: tri, atiSayena pfTuH । (pfTu + izWan .) atibfhat । iti mugDaboDavyAkaraRam ॥
v: praTizWa
tri॰ atiSayena pfTu--izWan praTAdeSaH । pfTutare । tatrArTe Iyasun praTIyas pfTutame striyAM NIp ।
m: प्रथिष्ठ mfn. broadest, widest, very large or great, RV.; ŚBr. (Pāṇ. vi, 4, 161, Sch.)
a: प्रथिष्ठ — a. Largest, widest, broadest; (superl. of पृथु q. v.).

v: praTu
pu॰ praTate praTa--un । vizRO “prARadaH praRavaH paTaH” vizRusa॰ ।
m: प्रथु mfn. (= पृथु) wide, reaching farther than (abl.), Rājat.
प्रथु m. N. of Viṣṇu, MBh.
a: प्रथु — a. Wide, wide-spread. --थुः An epithet of Viṣṇu.

v: praTuka
pu॰ praTa--bA॰ uka । vfTuke cipiwake rAyamukuwaH ।
m: प्रथुक m. (= पृथुक) the young of any animal, L.
a: प्रथुकः — Rice parched and flattened (cf. पृथुक).
